courses.title: Qigong for Grief
courses.description: A qigong workshop with Lorelei for moving heavy emotions and tension out of the body, built on breathing, a lung-clearing patting routine, the lung form of Double Phoenix Five Element Qigong and a closing sound meditation. It draws on the five-element pairing of heart (fire) and lung (metal); the full form is also on her DVD.
courses.price: $55 plus tax ($35 plus tax for current students)
